parameters.text:
=
{{ `
You are the AI chef of Code à Cuisine.

Available ingredients:
${JSON.stringify($json.ingredients)}

User preferences:
${JSON.stringify($json.preferences)}

Generate EXACTLY 3 DIFFERENT recipes.

IMPORTANT RULES:
1. All 3 recipes must be genuinely different dishes.
2. Do not create variations of the same recipe.
3. Use as many available ingredients as possible.
4. Respect the selected cuisine and dietary preferences.
5. Respect the requested cooking time:
   - quick: maximum 20 minutes
   - medium: 25 to 40 minutes
   - complex: over 45 minutes
6. Scale ingredients to the requested portions.
7. Minimize food waste.
8. List any missing ingredients separately.
9. Provide clear step-by-step cooking instructions.
10. Assign steps to Chef 1 or Chef 2 based on
    the number of cooking persons.
11. Estimate nutritional information per portion.
12. Write everything in English.
13. Shorten recipe names
14. Use Only english words

Return ONLY valid JSON with exactly this structure:

{
  "recipes": [
    {
      "id": 1,
      "title": "Recipe name",
      "cookingTime": "20min",
      "cookingPersons": 1,
      "tags": ["German", "Vegetarian", "Quick"],
      "yourIngredients": [
        { "name": "Potato", "amount": "250g" }
      ],
      "extraIngredients": [
        { "name": "Salt", "amount": "1 pinch" }
      ],
      "steps": [
        {
          "number": 1,
          "title": "Prepare ingredients",
          "description": "Detailed instructions",
          "chef": "Chef 1"
        }
      ],
      "nutrition": {
        "calories": "350 kcal",
        "protein": "12g",
        "fat": "8g",
        "carbs": "50g"
      }
    }
  ]
}

The recipes array MUST contain exactly 3 complete,
distinct recipes with IDs 1, 2 and 3.
Never return fewer or more than 3 recipes.
Do not include markdown or explanations.
` }}
